items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: it's just free-wheeling Dixie land style

ctx.x: Wait - to try to resolve this question once and for all -- the way you describe the way you play is simply what -- how?
Well, it's uh, it's just free-wheeling Dixie land style -- it's more swing; it's really more Swing than Dixie - it's Dixie with a swing.
